# Online Mbox Viewer

> A free, private, browser-based viewer for .mbox email archives. Your file is
> read entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

## What it is
- A static website (Astro) that reads MBOX/EML files 100% client-side.
- File size limit in the browser: 25 MB. For larger archives, the native
  desktop app "Mbox Viewer" for Mac and Windows is recommended.
- Privacy by design: HTML is sanitized, remote images blocked by default,
  nothing leaves the device.

## Key pages
- / — the online viewer (drop a .mbox file and read it)
- /how-to-open-mbox/ — guide to opening .mbox files and exporting them
- /compare/ — online viewer vs the desktop app
- /faq/ — frequently asked questions
- /privacy/ , /terms/ — legal
